registro.title: Sign up · {name}
registro.sub: Account per contracted site. Encrypted PII · required consent.
registro.faenaLocked: You are creating an account for site {name} (code {slug}). That is expected: each mine uses its own /f/{slug}/registro link.
registro.consentStore: I authorize storing my personal and company information encrypted.
registro.consentTos: I accept the terms of use.
registro.consentTruth: I declare the data provided is true and correct.
registro.ok: Account created. Check your email: you must verify before signing in.
registro.okHint: We emailed a verification link and pilot details. Without verification you cannot sign in. After day 15 without a paid plan, access is blocked. If the mail is missing, check spam or use Resend on the login page.
registro.okTrial: Pilot active: {days} days from signup. Then access is blocked until you subscribe.
registro.okMailFail: We could not confirm email delivery. Use Resend on login or check SMTP (ops).
registro.okRutNote: Company tax ID is checked for Chilean format/check digit only — not automatic SII/KYC.
registro.rutHint: Chilean format with check digit. Not automatic SII/KYC.
